scope.taskdb_authority: AITools/taskdb.py remains sole callback schema/claim/defer/delivery/stats authority
bridge_changes: sideband status reads callback_batches defensively for redacted parked-batch diagnostics only
busy/not_ready owner failures continue through BusyThreadError durable park path
no taskdb compatibility shim or import-time monkey patching
mux_changes: per-instance descriptors include generation_id, heartbeat_at, owner_lease_seconds and ready
owner resolution ignores live descriptors whose heartbeat exceeds the bounded owner lease
fresh active owners remain valid routing targets and are not interrupted or double-delivered

acceptance_evidence.requirement: stale owner disappears or is replaced while durable callback remains pending
genuine active heartbeating turn remains parked
expired ownership lease invalidates only stale active-turn observation
status exposes parked reason, age and owner/generation freshness

forbidden_regressions.interrupt_genuine_active_turn: fresh owner busy response remains SidebandThreadBusyError durable park
forbidden_regressions.drop_callback: stale owner resolution raises durable SidebandOwnerNotFoundError, not hard failure
forbidden_regressions.duplicate_delivery: reconnect generation test asserts exactly one turn/start to the fresh owner
forbidden_regressions.busy_retry_dead_letter: busy/not_ready subclasses BusyThreadError and existing B682/B684 suites cover non-dead-letter parking
forbidden_regressions.second_app_server_spawn: sideband owner recovery uses registry descriptors only and never falls back to AppServerClient
forbidden_regressions.taskdb_split_authority: callback_bridge contains no callback schema DDL or taskdb monkey patch
